summary: Indiana County, PA steel tower moved from Chickaree in 1930 and removed in 1978 per the register; the Clymer entry's 1930 build date conflicts with a 1921 build date.

facts.design: Steel tower; the Chickaree entry calls it a steel Aermotor tower
facts.status_note: Register says it was removed in 1978; no source describes the site now

events.note: Built as a steel Aermotor tower at Chickaree (Chickaree register entry)
Moved from Chickaree and renamed Clymer (Chickaree register entry; 1930 Indiana Gazette item)

evidence.supports: elevation 1,697 feet (517 m) per the register
steel tower; register dates its build to 1930, its move from Chickaree, and its removal in 1978
evidence.quote: This steel tower was built in 1930, moved from Chickaree and removed in 1978.

evidence.supports: Chickaree site is in Cambria County
steel Aermotor tower built 1921 at Chickaree, moved in 1930 and renamed Clymer
evidence.quote: This steel Aermotor tower was built in 1921. It was moved in 1930 and renamed Clymer.

evidence.supports: the old Chickaree tower, a 60-foot steel structure, was being moved to a new location near Clymer
evidence.quote: The task of moving the old Chickaree tower, a 60-foot steel structure, to its new location near Clymer, will be completed within a short time, according to the district forester.

evidence.supports: new site expected to give the towerman a wider view
evidence.quote: The new site will give the towerman a much wider visibility

resolved_conflicts.explanation: Clymer entry says built in 1930; Chickaree entry says built in 1921 and moved in 1930; the 1930 Gazette item describes the move. The story uses 1921 as the build year and 1930 as the move year.

notes_for_editor: Height 18.3 m in the brief matches the Gazette's 60-foot figure, which describes the old Chickaree tower; the Clymer entry gives no height of its own. Status 'gone' rests on the register's 'removed in 1978'. The Chickaree record (Cambria County) is a separate site and may need its own pass if it is not already queued.
